description: A durable identity with advertised capabilities (§3). Advertisement is provenance, not proof: it informs matching, never admission — carried from 1.1 §8 because the reasoning did not change.

capabilities.description: Declared feature identifiers (§6.3) and free-form descriptors. A capability token is `[a-z0-9-]{1,32}`, optionally with one `/<suffix>` version separator (finding V8: a profile identifier like [`HIVE_PROFILE`](super::HIVE_PROFILE) = `hive-recursive-pairwise/1` must itself be advertisable as a capability — before this fix the `/` made `validate_capability` refuse it). Anything a deployment invents beyond [`features::ALL`] negotiates as an unknown feature, which peers accept and cannot rely on.
